messages:
anita: deploy-bot failed during staging promotion: ECR rejected with tag immutability + KMS access denied when pushing to org repo. Anyone on-call?

deploy-bot: automated: publish -> aws-ecr 409 TagAlreadyExists; aws-kms DecryptionFailure for target registry key. repo `redwood/authz`, attempted tag `staging-rc-2026-03-21`. digest sha256:bb22cc...44.

raj: looks like CI reused tag `staging-rc-2026-03-21`. org registry has immutability ON and requires org KMS key for put-image.

infra-bot: policy: cross-account push must be signed with org KMS and transfer attestation. Fallback allowed: pin deployment to source digest for staging only with approver.

anita: immediate plan: pin staging deployment to digest so QA can continue. I'll coordinate manual republish to org account using infra credentials and correct KMS. Raj, can you add a follow-up PR to ensure CI writes unique promotion tags?

raj: on it. I'll change promotion step to append build id.

ops: doing manual republish is fine, but note cosign attestations will not move unless reattached. You'll need to cosign in org account or copy attestation blob.

release-coordinator: production window in ~2.5h. Manual republish + reattach should fit but if not, we'll slide. QA, can you test against pinned digest?

qa-bot: smoke queued against sha256:bb22cc...44. ETA 6m.

anita: approved for staging pin. ops, please set flag `staging_pinned_digest=sha256:bb22cc...44`.

ops: flag set. Automatic prod promotions paused.

qa-bot: smoke passed 6/6. QA signs off.

anita: lucidity check: lucy will do manual put-image with org kms, then cosign attach-blob and verify. If she finishes within 60m we keep the 21:00 window.

release-coordinator: please update release notes: "Authz: rc promoted to staging pinned by digest due to cross-account KMS and immutability; manual org republish + attestation pending for prod."

raj: opened PR to append buildid to promotion tag. ops-bot, can you add a rule to block deploy-bot promotions that reuse exact tag names?

infra-bot: created ticket: DEPLOY-4571 "prevent tag reuse on promotion".

anita: thanks team. keeping thread until prod rollout complete.
